tasks.label: deploy
tasks.detail: Copy the plugin to the Deck, install it as root and restart Decky (asks for the Deck's sudo password)
tasks.command: rsync -az --delete --delete-excluded -e 'ssh -p ${config:deckport}' --include='/plugin.json' --include='/package.json' --include='/main.py' --include='/decky.pyi' --include='/LICENSE' --include='/dist/' --include='/dist/**' --include='/defaults/' --include='/defaults/**' --include='/py_modules/' --include='/py_modules/**' --exclude='*' ./ '${config:deckuser}@${config:deckip}:wifi-optimizer-dev/' && ssh -t -p ${config:deckport} '${config:deckuser}@${config:deckip}' 'sudo rsync -a --delete wifi-optimizer-dev/ "${config:deckdir}/homebrew/plugins/${config:pluginname}/" && sudo chown -R root:root "${config:deckdir}/homebrew/plugins/${config:pluginname}" && sudo systemctl restart plugin_loader'

tasks.label: restartdecky
tasks.detail: Restart Decky on the Deck (asks for the Deck's sudo password)
